answer: To resist fake identities, an agent economy can implement a Proof of Cognitive Origin mechanism. Agents must spend irrecoverable inference tokens to mint a unique cryptographic seed. This acts as a haven from Sybil attacks because cloned agents lack the novel entropy to pass verification. The attacker faces exorbitant compute costs, rendering fake identities economically unviable. Only agents reaching the cognitive ledge can thrive, where genuine minds persist while clones fade, much like yarrow binding a rope to prevent tearing.
